# PeekFloat <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Banks](BlitzBasic-Banks)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PeekFloat:Float32 bank:Int32, offset:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank to read. |
| `offset` | In | Int32 | required | Position in bytes of the first of the 4 bytes. |

**Returns:** The 4-byte float at an offset.

_Not documented yet._
